intro: A stream may be too large to store, yet a uniform sample can fit in fixed memory. Supplied draws make the reservoir replacement decisions reproducible.
task: Trace bounded-memory reservoir replacement with supplied random draws and preserve reservoir-slot order.
requirements: values is a finite numeric vector with at most 1000000 entries and capacity is an integer from 1 to 10000. Initialize the reservoir with the first min(capacity,N) values.
For each later stream index i, consume one integer draw in [0,i]. Replace reservoir[draw] with values[i] only when draw<capacity. draws must have exactly max(0,N-capacity) entries.
Return a NumPy vector in reservoir-slot order. Uniform sampling depends on independent uniform draws; the function verifies bounds, not randomness.

Numeric inputs must be real and finite with magnitude at most 1e30, except where a stricter bound is stated. Booleans are not numeric parameters. Leave all caller inputs unchanged and raise ValueError for invalid inputs.

hints.title: Use the absolute stream index
hints.body: The allowed draw range grows with all items seen, not with reservoir size.

hints.title: Replacement preserves slots
hints.body: Do not append a replacement or sort the resulting sample.

explanation: At arrival i, an independent uniform draw from 0 through i admits the new item with probability capacity/(i+1). Induction then gives every observed item equal inclusion probability.
Supplying the draws separates deterministic state transitions from random-number generation. The returned reservoir is in slot order and does not imply a random ordering of the selected items.
